title: Nightscout follower - 5 min. delay
body:
Hi,
not urgent but annoying issue - while following Nightscout page you get the data between 5 and 10 minutes old. Users already found a workaround for that - set manual time on your phone 1 minute back and you get BG values 0-5 minutes old. This 1 missing record is important especially for children when the BG changes quick.

There has to be an option to fix that in xDrip+ ;)

Cheers,
Irek

comments.body: Funny, the two year old nightwatch app does not have this issue.

I was going to submit this issue now that I am using Loop, and want faster updates. Yeah, its about 5-10 delay. Then when it does get caught up, its never caught up to now, it's always 5 minutes behind. And yes, I have a kid too, so having current numbers would be nice.

I'm experiencing the same issue. I did all sorts of experiments today thinking the problem is on the Nightscout side. But it looks like xDrip+ is pulling data with a delay, or not frequently enough.

I'm preparing to start using Loop for my kid so the lag is an issue for me.
I have the same problem so have gone back to using nightwatch instead (I use it with a 3 yr old so current data is important.) Any idea why? Is it the same for all NIGHTSCOUT followers

In the Nightwatch settings I've decreased the Dexcom Share polling interval to 15 seconds:
`BRIDGE_INTERVAL = 15000` 

This almost completely eliminated the lag. 

Alternatively, we could investigate the Nightscout Follow logic. I believe it's in [NightscoutFollow.java](https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/blob/master/app/src/main/java/com/eveningoutpost/dexdrip/cgm/nsfollow/NightscoutFollow.java)

I have the same problem, is there any solution for it?
thanks

Still no solution, other than decreasing`BRIDGE_INTERVAL`

It doesn't fix the problem completely though.

So we use Loop and in the latest Master Branch they came up with a
workaround/option that can send the CGM data from the Dexcom/Loop phone
directly to NS. Its been working great for us. We currently let both ways
send in data and it appears to not duplicate the data. Plus you can also
see the delay on one of the pills hover over text.

[image: image.png]

The issue/delay is with the Dexcom servers.
